doc: Per-hunter run speed and acceleration in m/s and m/s^2 [reference data, notes in the private reports repo sv/]. Ids are our archetypes. climb_tall: the hunter can mantle double-high ledges (only archer and juggernaut). A hunter not listed uses its class speed and the default accel.

physics.doc: Ground stop, dash exit, air, fall, glide, dive and mantle tunables shared by every hunter [reference data, notes in the private reports repo sv/], in metres and seconds. brake (m/s^2): the constant part of the walking stop. ground_friction (1/s): the share of the speed a let-go sheds per second; together a let-go from a run stops in ~0.17 s and ~0.3 m. dash_exit_run: a dash ends at this share of run speed (never faster than the dash), so it carries into the walk, brake or jump instead of stopping dead. Air control is not here: the owner overruled the reference's low air control (11-08), see content/rules/tuning.json air. fall_cap (m/s): the fastest fall, easing to abyss_fall_cap between abyss_slow_from and abyss_slow_to metres under an island's lip over the abyss. glide_height: above it the glider pulls you down at up to glide_pull_vy; the drop never turns into speed (owner 11-08). glide_accel (m/s^2): the glider's pull toward where you steer at or under cruise, so a turn or a reversal has inertia (a reversal at cruise ~0.6 s). glide_start_vy (m/s): the slowest the glider falls the step it opens: a rising jump is cut to this fall, the open never adds speed (the canopy catch rate is ours, tuning.json glide.catch). turn_rate (deg/s): how fast the body turns to the cursor: a fixed rate, so a small aim change lands at once and a 180 takes 0.14 s. mantle_vy_cap / mantle_pull (m/s, m/s^2): within Hunter.MANTLE_REACH (1.5 m) under a lip the suction pulls you up only while you rise slower than the cap, so a jump's own momentum carries you over (the pull is flat over the reach). mantle_launch_keep / mantle_launch_min: the speed onto a ledge you climb (share of run speed, at least this many m/s). dive_vy / dive_accel (m/s, m/s^2): the glider's plunge while crouch is held under it; dive_steer: the share of the glide's steering force the keys keep in the plunge; dive_cancel_h (m): above the ground where the plunge ends and the glide catches you; dive_timeout (s): holding before it ends on its own.

glide_spike.doc: A spiked glider (scripts/match/glide_spike.gd, docs/decisions/0022). Spiked by heat (a player's hit that fills the glider's heat, or any player hit on an overheated one) [wiki Spike] or by a slam (a dunk driving it down at slam_min m/s or more, whatever its heat) [wiki Dunk; data SpikeSlamForceStrengthThreshold, value not decoded, ours est]. land_stun: the stun when a spiked glider lands over ground [wiki 0.7 s]. land_dmg: the additional damage then [wiki: 'additional damage', amount not stated, ours est]. air_stun: s stunned while it falls. fall_vy: m/s, the heat spike's plunge at least (SpikeSlamForceZ, value not decoded, ours est); a slam keeps its own speed. keep_hv: the share of horizontal speed the spike keeps. reopen_cd: s before the glider can open again. cool_by: the heat a gliding spiker's own glider sheds [wiki: spiking cools you; KINFALL 50 of 100].
